summary: Researchers reported that North Korea's Kimsuky hacking group used ChatGPT to create fake South Korean military ID card images as bait in phishing emails that delivered malware, mainly targeting North Korea researchers, activists and journalists.
technical_summary: The attackers used ChatGPT image generation to produce realistic sample ID cards, reportedly bypassing refusals with mock-up framing (prompt injection), then attached them to spear-phishing emails impersonating a defense institution. Opening the files launched scripts that installed persistent malware.

summary: Facebook's automatic Thai translation of a broadcaster's live post about the King's birthday ceremony produced a wording that offended many Thais. The government demanded an apology, police opened an inquiry, and Facebook paused auto-translation.
technical_summary: A neural machine translation system lacked enough royal Thai vocabulary and substituted a word associated with a memorial day for the royal birthday term. The error appeared in an auto-translated caption without human review and spread to viewers of a public broadcaster's page.

sector.quote: Thai PBS came under fire from viewers who spotted the mistranslated message on its Facebook page.

summary: ICE reportedly used an AI tool to screen job applications during a hiring surge, and it wrongly flagged many applicants as experienced law enforcement officers. Some recruits went to the field with shortened training until the error was found and fixed.
technical_summary: A resume-screening model classified applicants who merely had the word officer on their resumes as law enforcement veterans, routing them to a four-week online program instead of the full academy course. Manual review later identified affected hires, who were sent back for full training.

summary: A Chinese art museum displayed an AI-generated virtual character with a childlike face on an adult woman's body and suggestive movements. Critics accused it of sexualizing children and demanded removal, while the museum said it had been strictly reviewed.
technical_summary: A generative AI avatar combining a child's facial appearance with an adult body and exaggerated poses was shown in a public cultural venue. Design and review processes failed to prevent content widely seen as sexualizing a child image, prompting public complaints.
notes: The only excerpt is in Chinese with no word breaks, so all tags are marked inferred.

summary: The acting head of a US cybersecurity agency reportedly uploaded sensitive but unclassified contracting documents to the public version of ChatGPT, triggering security alerts and a Department of Homeland Security review of possible exposure.
technical_summary: A senior official given a special exception to use a public LLM chatbot entered documents marked for official use only. Automated data-loss sensors flagged the uploads, showing the risk of sensitive government material leaving federal networks through consumer AI tools.

summary: At an Arizona community college graduation, an AI system reading graduates' names malfunctioned, so some names were skipped or did not match the person crossing the stage. The college apologized to graduates and families.
technical_summary: An automated AI name-reading platform that plays synthetic announcements triggered by QR codes fell out of sync with the ceremony, with the displayed and spoken names not matching the graduates. A human reader was not on hand to catch the mistake.
